name: The Legend of Stalvan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity.  Innocent victims died by his hand.  Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes.  Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire.  The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting.  Travel to his cottage just north of town, Champion, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.

When the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring.  After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery.  But Darkshire is safer because of her.
narrative.objectives: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
narrative.offerRewardText: I know, adventurer: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning champion.

chain.subtitle: 13 quests from level 28 to 35, 13,250 XP in all.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Marshal Haggard wants you to check the chest upstairs for the Faded Journal Page.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Take the Faded Journal Page to Tavernkeep Smitts.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
